clips.title: The story
paras: Elder Rise gathers Thunder Bluff's spiritual guides and elders east of the central plateau. Long suspension bridges connect it to the High Rise and Middle Rise.

Swaying rope bridges link Elder Rise to Thunder Bluff's main mesas. Tauren druids and priests gather here to teach acolytes nature and spiritual devotion. Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem lives atop the mesa. He brought druidism back to the tauren and formed close ties with the Cenarion Circle. Nearby, tribal leaders meet in the Hall of Elders to discuss matters facing their young capital.

Elder Rise is a peaceful sanctuary, though political tension lingers. Magatha Grimtotem, matriarch of the secretive and haughty Grimtotem tribe, lives in a hut between the two bridges. Cairne Bloodhoof offers hospitality and council seats to all tauren lineages. Magatha's presence reminds the city that not every tribe shares the Bloodhoof's pacifist ideals or unquestioning alliance with the Horde.
